from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/wjc/repos/unisacc'); out=Path('/tmp/unisacc-r9-platform-evidence');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
target=sys.argv[1];probe=sys.argv[2];candidate=root/'unisacc.com'
blob=candidate.read_bytes();start=time.time();env=dict(os.environ,MODEL_COM=str(candidate))
cmd=[sys.executable,str(root/'tests/bound.py'),'55',sys.executable,str(root/'tests/modelcross.py'),target,'--probe',probe]
p=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,cwd=root,capture_output=True,timeout=58)
record={'schema':1,'scope':'unsigned frozen candidate model platform smoke, not bootstrap or signed trust','source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root).decode().strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(blob),'target':target,'probe':probe,'argv':cmd,'returncode':p.returncode,'seconds':time.time()-start,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')}
assert candidate.read_bytes()==blob
(out/(target.replace('/','-')+'-'+probe+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

original_scripts_source./tmp/unisacc-r9-mac-platform.py:
import sys,os,json,subprocess,tempfile,hashlib,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/wjc/repos/unisacc');target=sys.argv[1];arch=target.split('/')[1];out=Path('/tmp/unisacc-r9-platform-evidence');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);candidate=root/'unisacc.com';blob=candidate.read_bytes()
sources={'hello':'#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){printf("hello from C99\\n");return 0;}\n','fib':'#include <stdio.h>\nint fib(int n){return n<2?n:fib(n-1)+fib(n-2);}\nint main(void){printf("%d\\n",fib(10));return 0;}\n','convert':'#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){unsigned x=4294967295u;printf("%u %d %u\\n",x,(int)(unsigned char)257,(unsigned)(unsigned short)65537);return 0;}\n'}
start=time.monotonic();steps=[]
def run(argv):
 budget=min(12,int(50-(time.monotonic()-start)))
 assert budget>0
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'tests/bound.py'),str(budget),*map(str,argv)],capture_output=True,timeout=budget+3)
 steps.append({'argv':list(map(str,argv)),'rc':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')})
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(str(steps[-1]))
 return r.stdout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='unisacc-r9-mac-platform-') as td:
 d=Path(td)
 for name,source in sources.items():
  f=d/(name+'.c');f.write_text(source);host=d/(name+'.host');exe=d/(name+'.native')
  run(['cc',f,'-o',host]);want=run([host]);assert want
  got=run(['arch','-'+arch,'/bin/sh',candidate,'-run',f]);assert got==want,(target,name,'run',got,want)
  run(['arch','-'+arch,'/bin/sh',candidate,'-b',target,f,'-o',exe]);assert exe.stat().st_size>0
  got=run(['arch','-'+arch,exe]);assert got==want,(target,name,'native',got,want)
  print(target,name,'explicit model driver -run + compile/native = host',flush=True)
assert candidate.read_bytes()==blob
record={'schema':1,'scope':'unsigned frozen candidate model mac platform smoke; not signed trust or bootstrap','source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root).decode().strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),'target':target,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'steps':steps,'rc':0}
(out/(target.replace('/','-')+'-all.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
